title: HIKVISION PCI-T18F6S 8MP Fixed Turret Camera

comparisons.notes: Exact PCI-T18F6S 6mm lens, UPC 842571134056, in stock

writeup: Woot has the Hikvision PCI-T18F6S 8MP AcuSense fixed turret camera with a 6mm lens and up to 131 ft of IR night vision for $97.99. The only in-stock store we found carrying this exact model, DSG.direct, charges $430. Woot lists it as new, but the sale notes mention open box, so expect possibly rough packaging. Limit 3 per order; the sale runs up to 8 days or until sold out.
